 Social Security payment dates change in November. When checks arrive
 Sarah Moore and Joe Martino, USA TODAY NETWORK 2026년 10월 27일 화 오후 3:50 UTC 0 Social Security and Supplemental Security Income recipients should take note of some changes to the November payment schedule.
 Some payments will arrive earlier than usual because of the way the calendar falls, including the November SSI payment and one round of regular Social Security benefits.
 When is the November Supplemental Security Income payment?
 Supplemental Security Income recipients will receive their November payment on Friday, Oct. 30, rather than Nov. 1.
 That's because Nov. 1 falls on a Sunday. When an SSI payment date falls on a weekend or federal holiday, the payment is generally issued on the previous business day.
 That means there technically will be no SSI payment issued during November. The Oct. 30 payment is the November benefit, not an additional payment. The next regularly scheduled SSI payment is Dec. 1.
 SSI provides monthly payments to people with disabilities and older adults who have little or no income or resources, according to the Social Security Administration.
 When are Social Security payments in November 2026?
 Most Social Security recipients receive their benefits based on their birth date. The November schedule is unusual because Veterans Day falls on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
 Recipients whose birthdays fall between the first and 10th of the month normally would be paid on the second Wednesday. In November, that payment will instead arrive Tuesday, Nov. 10.
 The November schedule is:
 Advertisement
 Tuesday, Nov. 10: Birth dates from the first through the 10th.
 Wednesday, Nov. 18: Birth dates from the 11th through the 20th.
 Wednesday, Nov. 25: Birth dates from the 21st through the 31st.
 The Social Security Administration's normal schedule calls for payments on the second, third and fourth Wednesdays of the month, depending on a recipient's birth date.
 Who gets Social Security on Nov. 3?
 People who began receiving Social Security benefits before May 1997 generally receive their Social Security payment on the third of the month. The Nov. 3 payment date also generally applies to people receiving both Social Security and SSI.
 Those receiving both programs could therefore receive their November SSI benefit on Oct. 30 and their Social Security benefit on Nov. 3.
 How can I check my Social Security payment date?
 Payment dates depend on a recipient's birthday and the type of benefits received. Beneficiaries can check upcoming and past payment dates through their my Social Security account.
 The Social Security Administration also posts its annual benefit payment calendar online.
 When does the cost-of-living adjustment go into effect? 
 Recipients of SSI and Social Security will receive a 3.6% increase to their benefits in 2027. 
 SSI payments will increase starting Dec. 31, 2026, while Social Security benefits will see the change in January 2027, according to the Social Security Administration .
